assumptions: The implementation realizes the frozen successor contract only: the admitted neutral Profile payload schema, the pure resolved-experiment-plan compiler, the additive public API/CLI exposure, neutral fixtures and the frozen pytest-discoverable test identifiers. The rejected predecessor XDL1 attempt-1 draft is retained only as external review evidence and is not adopted as accepted design; where a predecessor revision already satisfied the frozen successor contract it was carried forward, and every successor delta required by XDL1-DD-13/XDL1-DD-14 and the 10.3 negative-evidence obligation was implemented and re-tested.

compile_experiment_plan consumes exactly immutable NormalizedResource values; the normalized-path unit and validation cases build those values with the repository-owned helper tests/thesis_lite/xdl/support.py (mirrors the accepted normalizer for the declared model surface). No accepted module, schema, private API or existing test is modified to enable it.

detailed-design.md section 10.3 is implemented as three explicit max_parameters scopes sharing XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED: scope 1 per declared extension parameterList (where each list is read), scope 2 the total compiled-parameter count C_total = len(parameters) + sum(lifecycleIntent[].parameters) + sum(faultSchedule[].parameters) evaluated once over the finished sections before identity finalization, and scope 3 each declared core System/Component spec.parameters[] list projected into components[].declaredParameters. All three are checked; the scenario-with-two-parameters-plus-two-one-parameter-steps case rejects at scope 2.

detailed-design.md XDL1-DD-14 is implemented as an always-present first components[] entry with scope='system' (instanceId/componentRef/nodeId null) whose declaredParameters project every System.spec.parameters[] entry and whose modelRefs project System.spec.models[]; each component-instance entry (scope='component-instance') projects its referenced Component's parameters/models. No System parameter is duplicated into a component-instance entry and none is dropped.

The plan emits every key frozen in detailed-design.md section 7 for each element, using null for an absent optional scalar and [] for an absent optional array exactly where the frozen example fixes them (nodeId, networkId, timeDomainId, duration, tolerance, retry, protocolBinding, mutability). Declared core parameters are projected as {id, valueType, unitSemantics, mutability} with no value or default.

Extension payload attachment order is canonicalized by attachment pointer before the resource and input semantic digests are computed; this realizes the frozen requirement that a permuted but equivalent payload order cannot change the semantic identity, and payload values keep their declared order.

compile_experiment_plan captures per-resource semantic digests at function entry and re-verifies them at identity time; content that is not representable in the canonical JSON encoding is rejected by a declared quantity gate before any identity or plan is emitted. Any error-severity diagnostic implies plan is None.

The trusted host owns the executable unit/static_analysis/integration/validation commands, the discovery/expected-identifier bindings and the assembled pinned target; local pytest runs in this stage are preliminary worker checks only and are not trusted or assembled-target evidence.

No scientific protocol value, threshold, tolerance, deadline, seed, margin or campaign parameter is defaulted, invented or narrowed; the seed, parameters, durations and tolerances are caller inputs and only the finite platform library bounds are enforced.

Only additive source/test/schema changes were made in this stage. The accepted xdl/schemas/v1alpha1/**, the C++ X-COM proto/source/contracts, the legacy/compat/blueprint artifacts, the accepted test suite and all historical engineering records are byte-unchanged.
findings: XDL1-RVW-001 (total max_parameters scope) implemented and negatively tested: the total compiled-parameter count is enforced over the finished sections before identity finalization (XDL1-DD-13, detailed-design.md section 10.3 scope 2); XDL1-SR-019-U::test_max_parameters_total_compiled_scope_exceeded_rejected and XDL1-VS-07::test_total_compiled_parameter_bound_exceeded_rejected_without_plan each declare per-payload lists individually within the bound whose total exceeds it and observe XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED with plan is None; XDL1-SR-019-U::test_max_parameters_all_scopes_at_bound_accepted is the boundary positive case. The task's scenario-with-two-parameters-plus-two-one-parameter-steps example is the validation case (C_total = 4 > 2).

XDL1-RVW-002 (declared System.spec.parameters dropped) implemented and positively tested: components[] always carries exactly one scope='system' entry first, whose declaredParameters project every declared System.spec.parameters[] entry alongside System.spec.models[]; XDL1-SR-002-U::test_system_core_parameters_projected_to_system_scope, ::test_system_core_parameters_not_dropped_when_component_parameters_present, ::test_system_scope_entry_always_present_with_empty_declared_parameters and XDL1-VS-07::test_system_core_parameters_projected_without_drop_or_duplication prove the neutral fixture's System parameter loop-count is projected exactly once at the system scope while each Component parameter nominal-rate remains in its component-instance scope, with no drop and no cross-scope duplication.

XDL1-RVW-003 (no negative case for XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED or any count-based bound) implemented and negatively tested: XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED now has one independent negative per declared bound scope in XDL1-UNIT (per-payload, total compiled and declared-core max_parameters; max_steps, max_faults, max_observers, max_metrics, max_dependencies_per_step, max_flows, max_bindings, max_resources, max_text_length, max_diagnostics) plus the merged-limitation count case in XDL1-SR-012-U, and the validation-level counterparts in XDL1-VS-07 (per-payload, total compiled, declared-core and declared-limitation negatives plus the at-bound positive). The 15 count-based XDL1-SR-019-U identifiers and the 1 XDL1-SR-012-U identifier named by the frozen unit-specification are present verbatim.
